characters.description: One half of the show's commentary team. The "Straight Man" of the group, Johnny is more professional than his co-host Nick Diamond, and is constantly calling him out for his crazy behavior andzany schemes. Has fought and killed Sam Donaldson along with Nick Diamond. Adaptation Dye-Job: In the original series, his hair was jet black, but in the revival, it was reddish brown. Catchphrase/Signing-Off Catchphrase:"Good fight, good night!"He also tended to say "OH MY GOD!" a lot. He also tended to say "OH MY GOD!" a lot. Deadpan Snarker: To Nick whenever the latter acts oddly.

characters.name: Recurring celebrities
characters.description: The undisputed champion ofCelebrity Deathmatch. He has fought and killedCharles Manson,Hansonand theSpice Girls(in a match that he wasn't even a part of),Garth Brooks, andRicky Martin, and has performed his music on the show. He voiced himself in two of the episodes that he appeared in, and has not appeared since the show wasUn-Cancelled. Affably Evil: He's the most evil man in America, but whenever he's being interviewed, he's rather polite and is on quite friendly terms with Nick and Johnny.But he really hates Hanson and the Spice Girls. But he really hates Hanson and the Spice Girls. Ambiguously Human: He usually seems to be a normal (if unrelentingly evil) guy, but in his fight with Ricky Martin, his hand, when cut off, is shown to be able to act on its own, change in size, and reattach itself. It's possible that he's some sort of demon or human-demon hybrid. Card-Carrying Villain: The most evil man in America.

characters.name: Charles Manson vs. Marilyn Manson
characters.description: Ax-Crazy: He's nuts, though givenhe's based on, it makes sense. Man Bites Man: He bites off a bit of Marilyn's shoulder in his fight. Stripped to the Bone: Marilyn Manson rips his skeleton through his mouth The Unintelligible: He only makes roars and grunts in his appearance.

characters.name: Deathbowl ' 98
characters.description: Tough-as-nails talk show host Kathie Lee Gifford. Action Mom: She addresses her kids in her introduction, and certainly manages to kick some ass. Revenge: She doesn't take the insults Stern said about her and her family very lightly. No Body Left Behind: Howard Stern's farts turn her into a pile of mush. Champion of morning radio, late-night television, books, movies, and the First Amendment.

characters.name: Seinfeld's Last Stand
characters.description: A beret-wearing intern. The President's... Last Lady.An intern who gained a ''lot'' of experience under Bill Clinton while enjoying a wide variety of positions at the White House.The First Lady of Lust. Big Beautiful Woman: Hillary openly calls the famously curvy Lewinsky a "flabby slut" and refers to her having a "big, fat ass", but Bill Clinton and Marv Albert seem keen on her. Enemy Mine: With Hillary when Bill asks Jones to grab his nuts. Product Placement: She plugs her book and website in her introduction. Signature Headgear: Her iconic beret. When Mils Lane tells her to remove the hat, she reveals it to haveblades like a shuriken.

characters.name: Where is Stallone?
characters.description: Trademark Favorite Food: King Ding candies. She tosses some into the crowd when she arrives to the ring. Oprah even waves some in front of her face before pulling it away, making Rosie ram her face into an unguarded ring post. The Alcoholic: He complains about the bar in the break room. He and brother get drunk later on. Cain and Abel: The Abel to Noel's Cain. Cain and Abel: The Cain to Liam's Abel Robotic Reveal: As a reference to the Terminator, a headbutt from Stallone damages his face and reveals his robotic exterior.
